subject: Re: Onboarding plan — projects, API keys, and invite schedule
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding plan — projects, API keys, and invite schedule

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the quick reply on the discovery call. To keep momentum we propose the following seed plan for your org so we can start the implementation sprint next week: 

- Tenant name: acmehealth-prod (we will provision a sandbox tenant first: acmehealth-sandbox)
- Seed projects: ingestion-test (for batch evals), chat-demo (for quick UAT), embeddings-ops (for embeddings workload)
- Initial roles: admin (2 seats), developer (4 seats), viewer (6 seats). We will send invites by role.
- API keys: short-lived key for dev/test, production key rotated at handover. We recommend using customer-managed KMS for prod key wrapping; see options below.

Action items:
1) Please confirm tenant name and list of initial admin users (email addresses) by EOD today.
2) Confirm whether you want Redwood to host keys or integrate with your AWS KMS (we can do both).
3) Any compliance constraints around logging/retention we should preconfigure?

I'll attach a concise seed checklist and will loop Marissa (implementation lead) to own the invites and provisioning schedule.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding plan — projects, API keys, and invite schedule

Ben —

Thanks, that looks straightforward. A few answers/questions: 

- Confirm tenant 'acmehealth-prod' and sandbox 'acmehealth-sandbox' are fine.
- Admins: myself (m.oneill@acmehealth.com) and Sofia (sofia@acmehealth.com).
- We prefer customer-managed KMS for production keys. Can you share the KMS key policy template?
- For SSO we will use Okta; we need a short checklist for SSO metadata exchange.
- Retention: logs must be retained for 1 year for our internal audit; can Redwood expose audit logs to our SIEM?

If you can provision sandbox and send invites for the two admins and 2 developers, we can start smoke tests Tues/Wed.

Regards,
Michael O'Neill
VP, Platform Engineering | Acme Health
m.oneill@acmehealth.com | (617) 555-9873
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding plan — projects, API keys, and invite schedule

Michael —

Great — sandbox tenant will be spun up today. Attached: rwinf-tenant-seed-checklist.pdf (quick checklist for provisioning, invites and SSO steps) and a draft role mapping spreadsheet. Highlights below:

- KMS: I'll drop the KMS policy template in the shared link and Marissa will coordinate the key rotation plan. If you want, we can pre-stage a wrapped production key so the cutover is one command.
- Audit logs: Redwood can stream audit logs to your S3 or push events to your Splunk/Datadog via webhook. Marissa, please confirm retention pipeline.
- SSO: we support SAML metadata exchange. Sofia, can you share your Okta metadata.xml and the nameid format you require?

Proposed schedule:
- 2/15 (today): sandbox tenant deployed, invites to admins + devs
- 2/16: smoke tests + basic API key exchange for test keys
- 2/17-2/18: UAT with your team, fine-tune role mappings
- 2/21: provision production tenant and KMS wrapping handover

Marissa — please take ownership of the invite cadence and KMS checklist below.

Attachments: rwinf-tenant-seed-checklist.pdf, acme-initial-role-mapping.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-16T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding plan — projects, API keys, and invite schedule

Ben / team —

Copying the thread into a short implementation plan (internal) and confirming I've started provisioning the sandbox. Full checklist below; I'll handle invites and the Okta exchange.

Implementation checklist (actionable items & owners):
1) Sandbox provision - Marissa (in progress) — tenant acmehealth-sandbox created 2027-02-15 17:02 UTC.
2) Admin invites - Marissa (actioned 2027-02-16 08:30 PST) — invitations sent to m.oneill@acmehealth.com and sofia@acmehealth.com.
3) Developer invites - Marissa (pending) — awaiting dev list from Acme (target: 2/16 afternoon).
4) KMS integration - Dev Patel (owner) — will share KMS policy template; plan for staged wrapped key on 2/21.
5) Audit log streaming - Laura Bennett (owner) — confirm S3 bucket name and IAM policy from Acme.
6) SSO metadata exchange - Marissa & Sofia — request metadata.xml by 2/15 EOD (Sofia sent shortly)

Notes:
- Attached 1) rwinf-tenant-seed-checklist.pdf 2) acme-initial-role-mapping.xlsx (working copy).
- DocuSign: not required for this initial work; production KMS handoff will include an HSM access attestation form.
- HubSpot: linked deal ACME-2027-014 — see notes for billing contact and contract term.

Next steps: I'll post a calendar invite for the kickoff session (30m) and share a short runbook for the invite acceptance flow (includes screenshots).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0210
